reason: I like the idea of ditching bottled water, but $68 up front for a bottle and filters, then a plan that keeps charging me, is a lot when I already carry a reusable bottle and my tap water is fine. Paying $13 shipping to skip the plan feels like they're pushing me into the subscription.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and I can't tell if these filters are any better than a cheap Brita-style bottle from Target.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle-only price around $30 with free shipping, and filters I can just buy once when I need them, no plan.
